channel.title: Daily MYRSS Digest
channel.description: Daily world affairs and cultural reading; RSS-based unless otherwise noted.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Philippine truth commission revises drug-war toll
item.description: A truth commission says the Philippine war on drugs claimed substantially more lives than previously known. RSS headline only.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Danish Supreme Court rules on controversial housing law
item.description: Denmark's highest court finds the controversial so-called ghetto law non-discriminatory, according to the RSS headline.

item.title: New York Times | Netanyahu's case for renewed strikes on Iran
item.description: Netanyahu argues renewed strikes are necessary for security; opposition leaders and military analysts question his motives. RSS summary.

item.title: New York Times | Drone attacks reshape Colombia's conflict
item.description: An attack in Cúcuta illustrates the growing use of drones in Colombia's conflict; the UN reports a sharp increase in drone bombings. RSS summary.

item.title: Follow the Money | Pesticide availability challenges industry claims
item.description: FTM finds that the number of permitted pesticide substances increased over twenty years, contrary to claims of shrinking availability. RSS summary.

item.title: Follow the Money | Deutsche Bank leak: five findings
item.description: A collaborative investigation examined fifteen million leaked documents from Deutsche Bank. Archive selection outside 48 hours to avoid repeating yesterday's FTM stories. RSS summary.

item.title: Reuters | US approval of allocated Patriot missiles reportedly delayed
item.description: The Financial Times reports that US approval for transferring roughly 60 interceptors to Ukraine remains outstanding. Reuters could not independently verify the FT report. Original Reuters reporting checked.

item.title: Reuters | Pakistani pilot set to join China's space station
item.description: Zeeshan Ali is scheduled to become the first Pakistani in orbit and first foreign national aboard Tiangong, a milestone in China-Pakistan cooperation. Original Reuters reporting checked.

item.title: The New Yorker | The Great Wealth Transfer Is Causing Trust Issues
item.description: A feature on inheritance disputes as baby boomers prepare to pass on their wealth. RSS summary.

item.title: The New Yorker | Christoph Niemann’s A Matter of Perspective
item.description: A cover-story selection exploring perspective in and out of the boardroom. RSS summary.
